datasets.name: Relic landslide dataset
datasets.source: Institute of Remote Sensing and Digital Earth, Chinese Academy of Sciences
datasets.verbatim: The employed dataset is constructed by a professional institution,1 and the landslide samples are labeled by experts following the procedure outlined below... 1Institute of Remote Sensing and Digital Earth, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

methods.name: mask-recovering and interactive-feature-enhancing (MRIFE)
methods.summary: A dual-branch semantic segmentation network designed for relic landslide detection. It uses a feature enhancement branch with masked feature modeling (MFM) and semantic feature contrast enhancement (SFCE) to address visual blur, and a self-distillation learning framework to mitigate overfitting on small datasets.
methods.source: Juefei He, Yuexing Peng, Wei Li, Junchuan Yu, Daqing Ge, and Wei Xiang
methods.verbatim: In this article, we propose a mask-recovering and interactive-feature-enhancing (MRIFE) semantic segmentation network to detect visually blurred relic landslides in a small-sized HRSI dataset.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not linked or referenced, and the custom MRIFE method code is not provided in any repository or persistent link.
